title: Palmyra
summary: Palmyra is an ancient oasis city in central Syria, first mentioned in the early second millennium BCE. It became a wealthy caravan city under Roman rule, reached its peak in the 260s under Odaenathus and Zenobia, and was levelled by Aurelian in 273. Its ruins are a UNESCO World Heritage site.

as_recorded.value: documents first mention the city in the early second millennium BCE

importance.justification: Major caravan city and seat of the Palmyrene Empire; its ruins shaped later classical architectural revival.
